description.value: Okome is a Japanese restaurant in Richmond whose name means 'rice' — the grain that anchors its menu and culinary identity. The brand draws on Japanese folklore, with a Kitsune fox logo representing the deity of rice and prosperity. Touring cyclists passing through Richmond's south end will find a sit-down or takeout meal option with online ordering available.

address.value: 11099 No 1 Rd Unit 150, Richmond, BC V7E 1S6

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack at 5m; rack at 57m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully accessible and confirms Okome is an active Japanese rice-focused restaurant at 11099 No 1 Rd Unit 150, Richmond, BC. Takeout is confirmed via the /order-online page listing both 'Order Delivery' and 'Order Pickup' options. No evidence on the website for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities — these are all null. OSM lacks a phone number but the website provides (604) 370-2270; the address matches between OSM and website (same street, OSM simply omits the unit number).
concerns: OSM record is missing the unit number (Unit 150) and postal code; full address taken from website. OSM also has no phone number; (604) 370-2270 sourced from website only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible restaurant with a functioning website and online ordering — a straightforward inclusion as a Food & Drink stop for touring cyclists.
